items.title: Harry Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Art Van Damme, Charlie Magnante, a bunch of excellent accordionists.

ctx.x: I think you should get it out at one of these festivals. See how fast you could clear the room. There’s been a couple of jazz accordionists, haven’t there? Art Van Damme?
Yeah. Art Van Damme, Charlie Magnante, a bunch of excellent accordionists.
Well you never know — if the jazz market goes way down the tubes, you might have to get that thing out. Well what was your school experience like in high school? Was it good for your jazz?
